assumptions: Digestion shows representative starch/protein/fibre only, compresses many reactions; fat/lymph route described separately.
Equal-volume 3D sphere model is exact geometry, not real alveolar anatomy. Relative partial-pressure units are invented; no transfer rate or personal values.
Blood paths combine each heart side into one station. Carbon tracer changes molecular form; glucose follows only a portion continuing after liver.
Single hidden-link comparison concerns complete new delivery, not instant loss of reserves, ATP or organ viability.
